outcomes: Decides between a capture, a quiet move and no special move in mixed positions with no theme named
Says what the opponent wants next before choosing a move
Names which part of a first look was missing when an answer was wrong
sources: Assessment lesson: items reused from shipped, machine-checked item files (IB4-9, IB3-513, IBds13-34, IG-COUNT-60, IG-MATE1-112, IG-MATE1-113, IG-STATE-8, IL-gHkeo, IL-TZA6v, IT-34csomhu-53, IT-55fg84kz-29, IT-5boxt60y-19, IT-2etwagdr-40); no new positions [V by tools/validate_lessons.py]

steps.text:
This is a **check**, not a lesson. Nothing is named: you will not be told which idea a position is about, and the answers stay hidden until you finish all of them.
Some positions ask for a quiet move, some ask you to turn down a tempting capture, and some ask what the other side wants next. Do not hunt for a trick that is not there.

steps.prompt: Pick the one question you would redo. What was the first thing you looked at in that position, and what did it leave out: the opponent's reply, a defender, or a move you did not consider?

fields.label: What the position was missing from my first look:
options: a defender or an attacker I did not count
a quiet move I did not consider
I did not check whether the move was legal or safe
nothing, I would not redo any
